resources.string: This phone or build cannot run desktop browsers: they need an arm64 phone and a sideload (personal or lab) build of AutoBridge.
Browser for the car\'s Web card
Deletes the Linux runtime and every desktop browser in it, with their profiles and caches. The built-in AutoBridge browser is not affected.
%1$s is downloaded from its publisher\'s own repository (about %2$s, including the Linux runtime if it is not installed yet) and checked against the publisher\'s signing key. Wi-Fi recommended.
Delete this browser\'s cache? Logins and bookmarks stay.
Start this browser with a fresh profile? The old one is kept as a single backup.
Keep the profile (logins, bookmarks) for a later reinstall, or delete it too?
Google Chrome is downloaded from Google\'s repository and is subject to the Google Chrome Terms of Service and Google\'s Privacy Policy. AutoBridge does not include or modify Chrome.
Choose Google Chrome or Brave under Settings › Desktop Browser Engine in AutoBridge on the phone.
Android limits how many background processes an app may run, and a desktop browser needs many. Turn on Developer options › Disable child process restrictions, or the browser can close by itself.

Android 12 and 13 limit how many background processes an app may run, and a desktop browser needs many. Lift the limit once with the adb command below from a computer, or the browser can close by itself.
Install it on the phone first: Settings › Desktop Browser Engine
Type, then Search to send it to the page
Hides the --no-sandbox warning with a managed policy. Turn off to run unmanaged; the browser restarts.
Start the chosen browser in the background when AutoBridge starts, so it opens instantly in the car
Reopen the tabs you had when the browser was last stopped, instead of the start page. A site opened from the Web card that is already open is not opened again
The page takes the whole window, with no tab strip or address bar. Use Address in the controls to type a link. Applies the next time the browser starts
Allow display while the car is moving
On: the browser stays usable while the car reports it is moving. Off: the car shows the park-to-browse notice unless the car reports parked
How soon the control panel folds away after the last touch
How far the page scrolls and the mouse pointer moves for each finger movement
Size of pages and of the browser toolbar. Changing it restarts the browser and keeps its tabs
List AutoBridge Chrome on Android Auto

Off by default: Chrome desktop as its own Android Auto app, so your phone\'s keyboard appears on the car screen and types into it. Parked only. Needs Android 15 or later and Unknown sources in Android Auto\'s developer settings. Reconnect Android Auto after changing.
Typing needs AutoBridge open on the car to confirm you are parked
The desktop browser is not running on the car
Open the notification on your phone to type
Turn on AutoBridge notifications on the phone to type with its keyboard
Typing into Chrome on the car
Tap to type into Chrome on the car with this phone\'s keyboard
Keyboard input for the desktop browser
For Netflix and other protected video on the car
Netflix and similar services will not play in the built-in browser. They play in Google Chrome or Brave for Linux, which AutoBridge can install here. Three steps; do them while parked.
Let Android keep the browser running
Done. Android will not stop the browser.
Downloads the Linux runtime and the browser you pick from its publisher, about 1 GB. Chrome is the safer choice for Netflix; you will see Google\'s terms first.
Installing. You can leave this page open or come back later.
You are not on Wi-Fi. The download is about 1 GB.
Only %1$s free. Chrome and the runtime need about 1.5 GB.
Available once a browser is installed.
Open the browser once to check that it works.
If the car is showing the browser-needed screen, it opens your site by itself now.
Three steps to watch Netflix and other protected video on the car
Tap to set up Chrome or Brave so %1$s can play on the car
Android stops apps that run many background processes, and a desktop browser needs many. Without this switch the browser can close by itself.
1. Tap Open developer options below.\n2. Find \u201cDisable child process restrictions\u201d and turn it on.\n3. Come back to this page. It moves on by itself.
1. On a computer, run the adb command (tap Copy adb command below, then paste it there).\n2. Come back to this page and tap the button below.
